description: Branches of the living tree were resorbed and reformed into trunk knots. Then, hundreds of years later, the oiled saw of a gorge woodworker disarranged the arbor geometry and flattened it for civil use. That history remains cast in two dimensions, powdered with dust and scratched in pencil.

native_definition.parsing: Exact source object fragments independently XML-parsed; no source rewrite.

native_states.scope: Read-only exact installed atlas metadata/masks; raw source retained privately. Native Inventory owns state/random choice.

source_shape: Broad flat wood top over two separated straight/splayed end supports and a low central stretcher. Upright Qud tile does not provide actual hidden depth or number of planks.
native_state: Native Inventory selects empty tile or one of4occupied tiles and independently chooses FullDetailColor C,c,y,W. Do not correlate shape/color to inventory identity or reroll state. One shared source table under all stock overlays.

palette.primary: w on entire wood structure including scratches/highlights
palette.empty_detail: C with zero native covered detail pixels
palette.ownership: Only source stock belongs to detail. Gold construction key is ownership, not an authored gold item.

stock_features.occupied-1: Tall narrow-neck vessel-like mark at left plus smaller upright mark toward center. Identity not established.
stock_features.occupied-2: Wide rectangular vessel-like mark with right-side open handle/slot. Identity not established.
stock_features.occupied-3: Rounded shoulder/narrow-top vessel-like form at right, small left upright mark and one tiny tabletop mark. Identity not established.
stock_features.occupied-4: Broad left stock form joined to open right rectangular frame, with two unequal upright projections. Identity not established.

stock_geometry_provenance: Vessel-like/handled/round terms describe source silhouettes, not resolved equipment definitions. Depth, roundness, wall thickness, unseen faces and placement are authored estimates; no exact bottle/cup/item inventory identity claimed.

reference.missing: No explicit drawSize/size in inspected XML ancestry; runtime defaults not exported. Texture dimensions are not physical dimensions.
reference.role: Actual VTE EndTable S/E/N gives restrained wood contours/grain and parallel cardinal map-camera end volume only. No drawer, knob, donor footprint or gameplay copied.

camera.projection: u=8+rotated_x; v=18+.45*rotated_y-z; same dimensions/elevation all facings.
camera.supports: Two trestle end boards atXÂ±5.3, thickness1.25, depth5.8; splayed end feet and one low X stretcher. Hidden board extrusion/shape is authored, not native limb count.
camera.provenance: Numeric dimensions inferred/authored from source broad top/supports plus actual donor presentation; no texture-frame ratio copied. End view retains full depth.
camera.west: Empty unmarked table can mirror E; occupied stock requires separate W projection/occlusion.

frame.rule: One common source-cell mapping for entire table and stock in all states/facings. No component/view production bbox fit.
